description.value:
Elvani sapiens - a fae-descended bloodline engineered and refined for centuries as corporate luxury assets: bodyguards, aesthetes, negotiators, and "companions" for the halo-spire elite. Elegant, ageless-seeming, and unnervingly graceful, the Elvani are fully mundane - no innate magic; any casting an Elvani performs is entirely class-sourced, the same as any other mortal.

Attributes: +1 Reflex, +1 Presence, -1 Physique. Obeys normal tier attribute caps.

Free at creation (Tier 5): the signature Ephemeral Grace (split into Alluring Poise and Fluid Motion), plus Ageless, Keen Senses, Elegant Bearing, and Graceful Step. Unified species, no subtypes. Breeds true; cannot interbreed.

Eight BP-purchased, tier-gated options span social, movement, stealth, and utility play - capped by Timeless Visage at Tier 1.

GWElvAdvFreeTr01.name: Signature + Free Traits
GWElvAdvFreeTr01.description: You gain the Elvani signature trait Ephemeral Grace (Alluring Poise + Fluid Motion) and the free package: Ageless, Keen Senses, Elegant Bearing, and Graceful Step.

GWElvAdvOption01.name: Species Options (spend BP)
GWElvAdvOption01.description: Optionally spend BP on a tier-gated Elvani option (Whisper-Step, Voice Mimicry, or Lucid Dreaming at Tier 5; Starlit Eyes and Unseen Passage at Tier 4; Court Connections at Tier 3; more unlock as you climb). Each option lists its BP cost and minimum tier.
